requirements.description: Bind TPS22918DBVR and the exact managed capacitor footprint. Preserve decoupling role/target VIN, selected capacitance and consumer positive-pad distance bound. Confirm effective capacitance, voltage rating and real part land pattern.
Host owns IC ground pin 2 and complete local return. The macro owns only capacitor return copper/via. Review host planes and connections after refill.

The owned 0.25 mm C-positive to VIN lead carries the switched load and input-bypass current. Qualify actual load/inrush current, copper thickness, voltage drop and temperature rise. The control_supply classification is not a rating for full load-switch current. Host owns VOUT/output bypass, ON/CT/QOD, IC ground and complete load/return loop.
Require native filled-board DRC, bypass/plane verification and independent assembly, courtyard, solder-mask and silkscreen review in the full consumer. Isolated fixture is not full-board acceptance.
Supply integrity, startup/transient behavior, thermal performance, EMI and all application-specific behavior remain unqualified.
